text_block_list.text:
One day, while out shopping with Hishi 
Akebono—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And guess what, Trainer! The cakes they 
sell near here—

text_block_list.name: Slouching Man
text_block_list.text: It's huge, get out of the way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, I'm sorry.

A man suddenly started yelling from behind 
Hishi Akebono. Even though the path was 
plenty wide, was he just trying to harass 
her?

However, if it were just me it would be 
fine, but I couldn't risk getting Hishi 
Akebono dragged into anything. As I held 
back, the man sneered and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Trainer! I'll be just fine~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks for getting mad for my 
sake~. Though personally, I like it better 
when you're smiling, Trainer~.
choice_data_list: Even though you did nothing wrong...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But maybe I really was getting in the way. 
Being big is a good thing, but I have to 
be careful!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I should walk along the edge... wait, 
whoa!

The slouching man who I thought had left 
is bothering another Umamusume further 
down the path. I really can't just leave 
this alone—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're the one in the way! If you want to 
swagger around swinging your arms like you 
own the place, go become a king or 
something!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Get lost already! Or are you looking to go 
one-on-one with me?!

text_block_list.name: Slouching Man
text_block_list.text: Eep... D-Damn it!
(*pitter-patter-patter*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, pathetic. If you're just gonna get 
scared and run away, you should've kept 
quiet in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing~! So cool! You had all the 
power and presence of a sumo wrestler!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"How's that fiery glare... looking? Did I 
nail it? Does it feel powerful?"
choice_data_list: The corners of your mouth are smiling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's a tough one~.
On the way home from shopping—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer, look! Hishi Ama's going after 
that person from earlier...!

Following their gaze, I saw a slouching 
man and his buddies surrounding Hishi 
Amazon.

Hishi Amazon is grinning and ready for a 
brawl, but getting into a fight would be 
bad. As the adult here—

Hishi Amazon is grinning and ready for a 
brawl, but getting into a fight would be 
bad. As the adult here—

text_block_list.name: Slouching Man
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who the hell do you think... Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmph!

text_block_list.name: Slouching Man
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Y-You're the one from before...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No fighting!!!!!

A voice booming like a giant taiko drum 
roared at the men. Its sheer force made 
the slouching man snap straight up to 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Slouching Man
text_block_list.text:
Eek! Wh-What's your problem...? Dammit, 
all of you are just... C-Come on, let's 
go!

With just a single word from Hishi 
Akebono, the men scurried away in terror.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To think that was enough to drive them 
off... It's kind of frustrating, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, Hishiama-san! Are you okay~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks. You were looking pretty cool 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer, did you hear!? Ehehe, I did 
it~!

"We decided to report that hunched-over 
man... It was a night where I got to see a 
powerful side of the usually gentle Hishi 
Akebono."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ! Mr. Police Officer! Oveeer heeeere!

Hishi Akebono waves her arms wildly across 
the crowd, sending a signal.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text: What happened!?

text_block_list.name: Slouching Man
text_block_list.text: Ah, crap...! R-Run for it!!

Sensing trouble at the sight of the police 
officer, the slouching man hurriedly 
gathered his companions and fled.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't really a big deal for me, 
but... Well, Fuji would get naggingly loud 
if she found out. Thanks a bunch, you 
really helped me out.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you waving your hand, I found 
the place right away. That was a big help. 
Thank you for your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way... T-Trainer.
choice_data_list:
It was hard to pinpoint your location just 
by your voice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Was it because of how big I am that they 
noticed me? ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so glad it was big after all~!

Basking in the gratitude and walking 
alongside a happily smiling Hishi Akebono, 
they made their way back proudly down the 
path.
